speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your recent travel, hiking, camping, and multiple recent illnesses, could you describe the nature of those past illnesses and whether you have had any fevers, headaches, or joint pain? Also, have you noticed any changes in your skin, eyes, or joints?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Urinary tract infection and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of weakness/fatigue worsening later in the day and mild diplopia (double vision) is classic for neuromuscular junction disorders, whereas a urinary tract infection does not cause diplopia or progressive fatigability. I am requesting specific diagnostic tests to confirm this. REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibody and REQUEST TEST: Chest_CT.
